claim: The executable upstream checkpoint is YOLOv8s-derived and was fixed before downstream evaluation.
TrackFeat uses an exact ordered 132-feature causal contract and a frozen 52-feature development reduction.
The 52-feature reduction was selected using training-OOF stability and redundancy evidence, not sealed validation.
Full-132 achieved P=.5102, R=.5435, F1=.5263 and 5.031 FPH on sealed validation.
Reduced-52 had the same validation recall but more normal false events and wrong-window alerts.
The event policy was selected only on calibration by the frozen recall-first rule.
TSC improved calibration recall but lost one established TP, was not selected, and was never evaluated on validation.
Feature-family heatmaps report training-OOF model attribution, not causal effects.
Trajectory-quality terciles showed no monotonic association with the frozen validation outcome; the analysis is descriptive, not causal.
The 21 full-model misses comprise D4=11, D2=7, D3=1, and U1=2 under the frozen diagnostic ledger.
Calibration-only episode midpoint increased TP 29 to 32 and reduced wrong-window alerts 15 to 12, but lost one existing TP and was rejected without validation execution.
The qualitative panels are deterministically selected held-out validation cases and displayed probabilities match the frozen full model.
The redesigned pipeline uses a real authorized calibration frame and exact frozen full-132 event-policy parameters.
The primary ACCIDENT grouped-OOF chain obtains T=.3128, S=.4127, C=.3432, and ACC-S=.3515 with paired video-bootstrap intervals.
Clip midpoint remains the strongest selected temporal control; T2-A does not improve T@1.
Highest-risk pair improves image-space S over closest-pair, while oracle time is labeled diagnostic.
Full-scene type evidence exceeds hard-pair type evidence; C2-C remains a modest Phase-2 diagnostic.
Phase-2 ACC-S=.3568 is report-only, includes 134 wrong-pair cases in its exact condition, and does not replace Prompt-1.
Approximately 40 false events per eight-hour camera shift is a projection from held-out FPH, not a field observation.
The system is a research prototype requiring substantial recall and false-alert improvement, not deployment ready.
After upstream perception, downstream scoring uses structured track features, while detector and ReID still process imagery.
The official ACCIDENT test remained unopened; ACCIDENT results are grouped-OOF development evidence.
